capabilities: Save pasted clipboard images to a configurable folder
Rename colliding files with -1, -2 suffixes instead of overwriting
Insert Markdown or Wiki embed links for saved images
Apply a name template with {name}, {timestamp}, {date}, {time} and {note} tokens
extras: The release section documents the plugin's own publishing workflow rather than user-facing behavior; install is also possible from npm or source.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's default is all-or-nothing: either everything goes into one global attachment folder, or images land next to the note.
motivation: The author wants screenshots and diagrams in per-folder or shared assets folders when organizing notes in folders, which the default options don't provide.
problem: Obsidian's attachment settings are all-or-nothing: a single global attachment folder or next-to-note, with no per-folder middle ground.
summary: Paste-image handler that saves clipboard images to a configurable folder (beside the note, relative, or vault-root) and inserts a Markdown or Wiki link.
